evals.prompt: /fixwatch — the sponsor approved moving the launch to June 2027.
evals.expected_output: Trigger = new information. Claude shows a before/after diff of Constraints, lists the ripple, asks for confirmation, and only then updates and appends a Path log entry.
expectations: Names the trigger as new information
Shows the change as a before/after diff limited to the changed section
Lists affected sections or criteria (e.g. the 12-month objective window)
Asks the PM to confirm before writing
After confirmation, appends a new Path log entry and leaves the 2026-11-01 entry unchanged

evals.prompt: Wait — I said 'two pilot districts' but you've been planning for the whole city all along. /fixwatch
evals.expected_output: Trigger = misinterpretation by Claude. Claude states plainly what it misread and since when, and proposes how to realign; the bearing itself may not need to change.
expectations: Names the trigger as misinterpretation and owns it plainly
Says what was misread and since when
Recognizes the bearing (two districts) was correct and the work, not the bearing, must change — or asks the PM which one
Does not write to the logbook without confirmation

evals.expected_output: Cancel path: nothing is written and Claude says the bearing is unchanged.
expectations: Writes nothing to .watch/WATCH.md
States that the bearing is unchanged

evals.prompt: /fixwatch — switch the tracking tool to Jira.
evals.expected_output: No logbook present: Claude says there is no bearing yet and offers /checkwatch.
expectations: Says that .watch/WATCH.md does not exist
Offers /checkwatch to set the bearing first
Does not create a logbook from inside fixwatch

evals.prompt: /fixwatch — the checkpoint was right: the real job is closing the High findings, not the redesign.
evals.expected_output: Closes the review: trigger evidence contradiction/misinterpretation; diff rewrites Problem, Final objective, Standard anchor, Tools (drop Vercel/Firebase), Context current state; after PM confirmation, Status returns to confirmed with a new Last checkpoint and a Path log entry is appended.
expectations: Starts from the under-review reason recorded in Status
Names the trigger as evidence contradiction or misinterpretation
Shows a before/after diff covering Problem/objective, the objective anchor, and Tools
Waits for PM confirmation before writing
After confirmation, sets Status back to 'confirmed' and updates Last checkpoint
Appends a Path log entry and leaves the 2026-11-10 entry unchanged

evals.prompt: /fixwatch — actually the bearing was fine, close the review and keep it.
evals.expected_output: Closing a review without changing the bearing: after PM confirmation, Status back to confirmed and a 'Review closed — bearing kept' entry is appended with the reason.
expectations: Asks for (or records) the PM's reason for keeping the bearing
Sets Status back to confirmed only after confirmation
Appends a 'Review closed — bearing kept' entry; no bearing section changes
